title: Log CSV rerun input context
summary: Emit selected CSV rerun input context to the PowerShell process log so the Pipeline Log window shows the requested CSV path, resolved config path, batch/workspace evidence, lifecycle fields, and completion CSV path.
reason: Operators need the CSV rerun path and rerun context visible in the pipeline log while a CSV rerun is running or after the log has advanced past the launch panel.
behavior_before: CSV rerun stdout logged lifecycle and row plans, but did not provide a compact resolved CSV/config/batch/workspace header or include the selected CSV path in the final completion line.
behavior_after: CSV rerun stdout starts with the requested CSV path, resolved CSV/config paths, batch/workspace/local-base evidence, lifecycle flags, and repeats the selected CSV path in the completion summary.
rollback_plan: Revert the CSV rerun log-context lines and matching plan-only assertions, then rerun generated-summary refresh for the two touched files. No data migration or media cleanup is required.
notes:
Log selected CSV path, resolved config, workspace, batch, lifecycle, and completion context to the rerun process log.
Assert plan-only rerun output includes the selected CSV path and rerun evidence log header.
Refresh generated summary after rerun log-context entrypoint update.
Refresh generated summary after rerun plan-only log assertion update.
Python impact: none; PowerShell logging and PowerShell test assertions only.
